newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices ease on slow festival demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices ease on slow festival demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on Monday owing to fresh arrivals and slow festival demand, dealers said.
"Demand for the kite festival turned slow at the wholesale level and now there will be festival oftake only at retail counters," one broker said.

Ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 5/10 rupees to 1,250/1,295 rupees per quintal while M-30 eased by five rupees at 1,300/1,375 rupees. Sugar mill delivery fell by 10 rupees at 1,180/1,190 rupees per quintal.
